description: This source file defines the `I18NTranslationBulkAPI` class, an API endpoint for bulk updating internationalization (i18n) translation strings in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class uses traits for localization services and entity management, and implements API methods for updating translation data via HTTP PUT, including validation rules and transaction management.
